title: 1 Peter Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on 1 Peter 1: a living hope, faith tested like gold, and the word that endures forever.

questions.text: Who does the opening verse name as the writer of this letter?
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 1:1 opens: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion.

answers.text: James, a brother of the Lord
Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ

questions.text: In which regions are the chosen ones living as foreigners?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 names the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.

answers.text: Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia

questions.text: Through what were they caused to be born again to a living hope?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says that according to his great mercy God caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead.

answers.text: The law given to the fathers

questions.text: Where is their inheritance reserved, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 speaks of an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn't fade away, reserved in Heaven for them.

questions.text: The proof of their faith is said to be more precious than what?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says the proof of your faith is more precious than gold that perishes even though it is tested by fire.

questions.text: Who sought and searched diligently concerning this salvation?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says that concerning this salvation the prophets sought and searched diligently, and prophesied of the grace that would come.

questions.text: On what are they told in verse 13 to set their hope fully?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says: be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

answers.text: On the grace that will be brought to them
On the praise of the nations
On the strength of their own minds
On the riches of this present age

questions.text: What words are quoted in verse 16 as written?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says: because it is written, “You shall be holy; for I am holy.”

answers.text: Be merciful, for I am merciful
You shall be holy; for I am holy
Fear God and keep his word

questions.text: With what were they redeemed, according to verses 18 and 19?
questions.explanation: Verses 18 and 19 say they were redeemed not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ.

answers.text: With the precious blood of Christ
With the words of their fathers

questions.text: What is all flesh compared to in the words quoted in verse 24?
questions.explanation: Verse 24 quotes: all flesh is like grass, and all of man's glory like the flower in the grass; the grass withers, and its flower falls.
